final_grader.about: Every run on the R8 build or later, graded again offline from its own exports by the final grader. T01's grader is at f66efa2, which credits a change record that names its change in shorthand (C9: cd49049, then f66efa2 for a value a word or two past the arrow and the verb of a paused flag); regraded with it, every T01 run from R8 to R16 keeps its row, gate and D12 except five of the six R14 Astra runs (C9, 0.97 to 1.00). The R15 runs were built at 1633470, whose grader is 689ab3b's; f66efa2 moves none of them. The R16 runs were built at f79c1db, whose grader is f66efa2's. T03's grader is unchanged since 689ab3b; runs through T03R3 were regraded at 9b076a2 and the later grader changes move none of them. A judge row keeps its recorded votes when the final grader sends the judge the same prompt; otherwise it is re-judged once (3 samples) with the final prompt. Only grader changes can move a score: world and colleague fixes can't change what a recorded run did. losses says whose the points a run still loses are: fair (the agent's), env (a world or colleague defect fixed since), or mixed.
